The '''Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory located on a [[Unidentified planet (Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory)|planet]] close to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].

==History==
The factory was owned by the [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] [[Quingarus]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he got a loan with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], who threatened him to produce a [[Upgraded battle droid|new model]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] for them as payment. The facilities were secured for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] secured a deal with Quingarus to have all the Republic's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] maintained by his factory.
